summary: Practise outbreak risk assessment, incident coordination, surveillance, and health service continuity. Explore the five-day course and curriculum.
lede: Pandemic response training helps public health emergency coordinators, surveillance specialists and health service managers prepare for outbreaks while sustaining essential health services. Participants practise assessing risk, designing surveillance and escalation workflows, and coordinating incident actions using public health emergency frameworks; they also develop response dashboards and after-action review outlines from scenarios and sample data. Digital surveillance and AI-assisted signal triage are introduced at a conceptual level.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who coordinate public health emergency readiness, outbreak response, or continuity of health services. It suits roles that need to make decisions across surveillance, operations, clinical delivery, and public communication.
audience: Public Health Emergency Operations Centre leads
prerequisites: Prior experience or working familiarity with public health, health services, emergency preparedness, surveillance, or response coordination is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop if you want to work directly with the digital dashboard template; no specialist software installation is assumed.
